name: Steakhouse High Yield USDC Edition
oneLiner: sirloinUSDC is Steakhouse’s Morpho V2 USDC lending vault; shares accrue yield, absorb strategy losses, and redeem against available liquidity.
collateral: USDC held idle in the exact Morpho VaultV2 and supplied through its sole MorphoMarketV1 adapter; borrower collateral and market liquidity determine strategy risk.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 shares represent a proportional USDC-denominated lending position. Interest and fee-share accrual change assets per share; bad debt reduces NAV. Holder withdrawals burn shares and pay USDC atomically when idle assets plus the selected liquidity adapter suffice.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: The current holder claim is the operational ERC-4626 claim at base:0xbeeff2490feffa212fac2f6553682c219e6a8845, not direct ownership of the parent’s fiat reserves. Exact verified immutable VaultV2 code pulls underlying before user mint, can mint fee shares during interest accrual, and burns receipts against available underlying on exit. Reverified at block 52095842; parent fiat-cash protections remain upstream. Exact implementation creation is pinned by transaction 0x365e979eb98424e0fcedad75285d1c9ae4cd4be4a3a3841318666316f4082bf7, block 45427904, timestamp 2026-05-01T14:19:15+00:00, independently joined from Blockscout to RPC receipt and block timestamp on2026-10-03. This is the implementation launch, not issuer founding or parent-token launch.
